profile_text.body:
Ericsson LM Telephone Co is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC, with the CIK 0000717826. Its website describes it as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI, and cloud for both network providers and enterprises.

In its own framing, the company positions AI as part of connectivity rather than a separate line of business. It describes enterprise offerings that unite 5G, AI, and cloud for secure and reliable connectivity, and advanced 5G capabilities including network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools. It also cites research with Qualcomm tracing the network implications of AI-driven XR from today's 5G to 6G, and sets out a perspective on 6G as an "intelligent fabric" connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems. The site also references an Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) transformation at AT&T, described as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The material available on the company's site is largely promotional and forward-looking, covering 5G, 6G, and AI-driven automation at a general level rather than naming specific AI products.
